timeline.title: Hair and Makeup Starts
timeline.desc: Bridesmaids and mother of the bride first. Bride starts at 09:30 AM.

timeline.title: Groomsmen Getting Ready
timeline.desc: Groom and groomsmen dress. Photographer captures details (rings, suit, shoes).

timeline.title: First Look & Couple Portraits
timeline.desc: Private first look. Photographer & videographer shoot couple portraits.

timeline.title: Wedding Party & Family Photos
timeline.desc: Shoot immediate family, bridesmaids, and groomsmen.

timeline.title: Groom & Guests Arrival
timeline.desc: Ushers stand in position. Pre-ceremony music starts playing.

timeline.title: Wedding Ceremony
timeline.desc: Processional starts. Vows exchange, rings exchange. Recessional at 04:35 PM.

timeline.title: Cocktail Hour
timeline.desc: Guests enjoy appetizers and signature cocktails. Couple takes sunset pictures.

timeline.title: Grand Reception Entrance
timeline.desc: Guests seated. Entrance of wedding party and bride/groom. First dance.

timeline.title: Dinner Service & Speeches
timeline.desc: Plated dinner served. Best Man, Maid of Honor, and parents give toasts.

timeline.title: Dance Floor Opens & Cake Cutting
timeline.desc: DJ Dave sets off. Cake cut at 08:30 PM. Late night snacks served at 10:00 PM.

timeline.title: Grand Sparkler Send-off
timeline.desc: Guests line up with sparklers. Bride and Groom exit.

messages.text: Hi! I'm thrilled to be planning your wedding. Have you had a chance to look at the draft catering menu yet?
Hi Olivia! Yes, we love the plated options from Culinaria Fine Dining. We have a tasting next week.
Good morning! The Grand Pavilion lawn has been locked in for your date. I have sent the contract details over.
